scripts.test: npm run test:security && npm run test:clinical && npm run test:chaos && npm run test:stress
scripts.test:security: tsx -e "import { securityRbacTestSuite } from './backend/tests/securityRbacTestSuite'; const res = securityRbacTestSuite.runAllSecurityTests(); if (!res.allPassed) { console.error('Security assertions failed'); process.exit(1); } else { console.log('✓ Security assertions 100% passed'); }"
scripts.test:clinical: tsx -e "import { clinicalScenarioTestSuite } from './backend/services/clinicalScenarioTestSuite'; clinicalScenarioTestSuite.runAllScenarios().then(r => { if (!r.allPassed) { console.error('Clinical safety assertions failed'); process.exit(1); } else { console.log('✓ Clinical safety scenarios 100% passed (' + r.passedCount + '/' + r.totalScenarios + ')'); } });"
scripts.test:chaos: tsx -e "import { FailureChaosTestingService } from './backend/services/failureChaosTestingService'; const rep = FailureChaosTestingService.runChaosSuite(); if (!rep.allPassed) { console.error('Chaos assertions failed'); process.exit(1); } else { console.log('✓ Chaos & Failure resilience 100% passed (' + rep.passedCount + '/' + rep.totalChaosTests + ')'); }"
